# 1059 - Even Numbers

**Category:** Beginner (Repetition Structures)

## Description

Write a program that prints all even numbers from 2 to 100, one per line.

## Input

No input.

## Output

Print all even numbers from 2 to 100, one per line.

## Example

| Input | Output |
|-------|--------|
| (none) | 2<br>4<br>6<br>...<br>100 |

## RPython Features Used

- `var` for mutable variable declaration
- `while` loop for iteration
- Conditional check for even numbers
- Integer arithmetic (`+`)
- `print_line()` for output
